items.briefing:
Microsoft has released emergency security fixes following its recent large Patch Tuesday update — if your organisation uses Windows, ensure IT has applied these updates promptly. Separately, Cisco has patched a zero-day vulnerability in its Secure Email Gateway that was actively being exploited, so any organisation using Cisco email security should confirm updates have been applied. A low-cost hacking tool called VectraRAT is also circulating, available for as little as $250 per month, making targeted attacks on businesses more accessible than ever.

Closer to home, a new article highlights that universities and training organisations face growing cyber risks tied to user identity management — a timely reminder for RTOs to ensure staff and student accounts have strong, unique passwords and multi-factor authentication enabled.

**Practical tip:** Check with your IT team today that Windows and Cisco email systems are fully patched and up to date.
